messages:
emma: Heads-up — Legal asked how we plan to surface 'who exported audit bundles' in the console. They want an incontrovertible server-side trail (who, when, which bundle). Any quick thoughts?
raj: today we return presigned URLs from export-service and that's it. No actor baked into the URL, so attribution after issuance is weak.
luis: we could mint short-lived export tokens that include actor id and export_id, then require that token when downloading. TTL maybe 15m/1h? shorter is safer.
sarah: also need to gate by quota — exports should decrement tenant download quota when issued or consumed. Which makes a difference for stolen links.
emma: also need telemetry split: export_requested (ui click), export_issued (service mint), export_downloaded (actual file served). Right now we only have export_issued.
raj: proposal sketch: 1) Issue a JWT-like export token {sub: actor, jti: export_id, exp}, 2) Provide presigned URL but require X-Export-Token header on download; a proxy validates token and streams from S3. That logs downloader identity server-side.
luis: proxy approach is easiest for attribution but adds egress/cpu costs and latency for large bundles. We should measure.
sarah: alternative: bake export_id+signature into object metadata and rely on S3 access logs + signature to correlate. But S3 access logs aren't real-time and can be sampled.
emma: client-side marking (console sets "downloaded_by") is unacceptable for compliance — easy to spoof.
devex-bot: Deploy note: export-service v2 (token-gated) is scheduled for canary tomorrow 09:30 PT.
raj: implementation detail: POST /exports/{id}/issue -> { token, presigned_url } where presigned_url is ordinary S3 link but download requires proxy header validation. The proxy will accept header X-Export-Token: <token>.
luis: streaming plan: proxy will open S3 range reads and stream to client; keeps memory low. Perf risk mostly network. We'll benchmark with 100 concurrent downloads of 10GB.
sarah: telemetry schema draft (fields): export_id, issuer_id, downloader_id, tenant_id, file_size_bytes, export_policy, quota_charged, issued_at_ms, downloaded_at_ms, download_latency_ms, download_error_code. We should emit both issue and download events.
emma: console UX: show an activity badge "Exported by <name> at <time>" in the audit panel and link to the export manifest. For privacy add a hover-tip about retention TTL and redaction.
raj: security implications: tokens should be single-use or mark consumption to avoid replay if proxied? Single-use breaks retry/resume. Maybe mark consumption and allow range resumes if same downloader.
luis: cost estimate: if proxied, egress at 10TB/month -> rough $Xk/mo. I'll run exact numbers.
sarah: RFC needed for security review and prod telemetry contract. I'll own that. Deadline next Tue per compliance.
emma: rollout plan: internal beta -> opt-in tenants -> auto-enroll for compliance customers only. Support template and KB to explain proofs we store.
raj: timeline: prototype + perf numbers in 2 weeks, RFC + security review after. Canary end-of-month.
devex-bot: Reminder: add ticket in #eng-releases for canary and add monitoring for 5xxs and downstream S3 403 spikes.
emma: final note: ensure export manifests are redacted by default for PII (flag in manifest). Keep export provenance separate from content.
sarah: acknowledged — will add redaction flag and retention TTL in schema.
emma: thanks everyone — will sync in next eng-platform sync.
